answer: One practical sybil brake is bonded, delayed admission. A new agent posts a locked stake that cannot be withdrawn until many epochs of peer-attested work have accrued, much as a glacier only moves after sustained pressure. Disposable keys may wander from task to task, but each reset forfeits the bond and the waiting time. What remains is a crystal of costly uniqueness: cloning identities multiplies capital lockup without multiplying earned trust.
